components.name: Arc-Reactor Orb
components.description: Voice-mode signature: segmented ring, inner ring, glowing core scaled by --level.
components.css: .ds-stage{display:grid;place-items:center;padding:32px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 40%,#0f2331 0%,#081118 55%,#05090e 100%)}.ds-orb{--level:0;--size:200px;position:relative;width:var(--size);height:var(--size);border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center}.ds-orb i{position:absolute;border-radius:50%}.ds-orb i:first-child{inset:0;background:repeating-conic-gradient(#3ccff2b3 0 21deg,transparent 21deg 30deg);-webkit-mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent calc(100% - 4px),#000 calc(100% - 3px));mask:radial-gradient(farthest-side,transparent calc(100% - 4px),#000 calc(100% - 3px));animation:ds-spin 28s linear infinite}.ds-orb i:nth-child(2){inset:15%;border:1.5px solid #3ccff266;box-shadow:inset 0 0 calc(16px + var(--level)*44px) #3ccff22e;transform:scale(calc(1 + var(--level)*.06))}.ds-orb b{width:34%;height:34%;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,#effcff 0%,#86e6fb 24%,#3ccff2 48%,#0d5568 72%,transparent 74%);box-shadow:0 0 calc(28px + var(--level)*90px) calc(3px + var(--level)*16px) #3ccff259;transform:scale(calc(.92 + var(--level)*.34))}@keyframes ds-spin{to{transform:rotate(1turn)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-orb i{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Ninja is one calm, dark workshop built around a single companion. The rooms are navy, not grey: five stepped tones from ground to raised surface carry all structure, separated by thin cool lines. Light in the room comes from one source, the arc-reactor cyan that marks Jarvis and the next obvious action, and from one secondary lamp, a warm gold that only ever counts things or proves that something happened.

Density is Operate-mode: a fixed labelled rail, a slim top bar, and a centred conversation column with nothing competing for the eye. Surfaces are flat and crisp. Glow is rationed: it lives in the voice-mode orb, the Jarvis empty-state mark, focus and active rings, and the connection dot. Everything else is edge, tone and type.

Type is Windows-native Segoe UI Variable with Nirmala UI behind it, so Devanagari and Latin share one line comfortably. Conversation text runs larger and at full contrast than interface text, because reading Jarvis is the main job.
keyCharacteristics: Navy tonal layering, five steps, no grey.
One accent (arc cyan) for Jarvis and primary actions only; gold for counts, reminders and receipts only.
Labelled icon rail that becomes a bottom tab bar on phones.
One authored line-icon set, 1.75 stroke, recoloured by state.
Native `<dialog>` drawers for secondary places (History, Today).
The arc-reactor orb is the single signature element.

rules.name: The One Light Source Rule
rules.body: Cyan appears only on Jarvis and on the one primary action of a view. A second cyan button on a screen means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Gold Means Proof Rule
rules.body: Gold marks a number, a due reminder or a verified receipt. It is never decoration and never a second accent.

rules.name: The Read-Jarvis-First Rule
rules.body: Conversation text is always larger (15px) and brighter than interface text (13px muted). Never shrink a reply to fit chrome.

rules.name: The Rationed Glow Rule
rules.body: Glow is allowed on the orb, the empty-state mark, focus and active rings, and the connection dot halo. Cards, buttons, text and borders never glow.

dos: **Do** keep every surface on the navy ramp (ground, rail, surface, surface-raised, surface-high) and separate planes with 1px cool lines.
**Do** reserve arc cyan for Jarvis and the one primary action per view.
**Do** use receipt gold only for counts, due reminders and verified receipts.
**Do** draw icons from the single authored set: 24px grid, 1.75 stroke, round caps and joins, `currentColor`.
**Do** set conversation text at 15px / 1.65 in full-contrast text so mixed Devanagari and English stay legible.
**Do** give every control the 2px cyan focus outline and honour reduced motion.
**Do** open secondary places (history, today) in native dialog drawers rather than new pages.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce the legacy lavender accent (`#d1c6ff` family) or neutral greys on new surfaces.
**Don't** add glow to cards, buttons, text or borders; glow belongs to the orb, the Jarvis mark, focus and active rings and the status dot.
**Don't** use gold as decoration or as a second accent.
**Don't** create a second signature element; the orb is the only one.
**Don't** use letter glyphs, emoji or text arrows as icons; use the authored SVG set.
